items.title: Add done_prepare command surface and preflight
items.context: Create the CLI command entry and handler input contract for a pre-DONE readiness assistant. It must resolve the requested story/worktree, require TEST phase, require a clean worktree before mutation, and avoid any version-file mutation.
items.userSees: User sees literal output such as "done_prepare" in lattice help, then "DONE prepare: BLOCKED" or "DONE prepare: PASS", "storyId: B-xxxx", "phase: TEST", "preflight: PASS", and "worktreeClean: PASS"; protected version files remain absent from git status.

happy.desc: From the correct story worktree in TEST phase with a clean tree, lattice done_prepare --storyId=B-xxxx resolves the requested story, recognizes the expected story branch, applies documented defaults for mergeMain, refreshStale, validate, build, and dryRun, and reaches the preflight step without touching version files. WHY: proves the command surface and handler input contract are wired for the pre-DONE assistant.

edge.desc: From a valid worktree but a non-TEST story phase, lattice done_prepare --storyId=B-xxxx fails closed before merge, validation, evidence refresh, or runtime detection. WHY: prevents TEST PASS and DONE closure mechanics from leaking into earlier lifecycle phases.

adversarial.desc: Run done_prepare for B-xxxx from the wrong cwd, wrong branch, missing local main, or with a dirty worktree before mutation; it refuses to continue and does not stash, clean, auto-commit, merge, refresh evidence, validate, or mutate version files. WHY: automated preparation must not hide workspace ownership or dirty-tree hazards.

items.title: Orchestrate merge-main, stale evidence classification, validate, and done_closure
items.context: Reuse existing Lattice logic where possible. Stale evidence must be classified with dry-run semantics first; only safely refreshable evidence can be refreshed, otherwise output rerun commands and stop.
items.userSees: User sees step rows "mergeMain: PASS", "staleEvidenceRefresh: PASS", "validate: PASS", and "doneClosure: PASS" on success; blocked runs show "blockedAt: evidenceFreshness" or "blockedAt: validate" plus a literal next command such as "lattice verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=B-xxxx".

happy.desc: For a clean TEST story where main merges cleanly, stale evidence is either absent or safely refreshable, validation passes, and done_closure reports canAttemptDone=true, lattice done_prepare --storyId=B-xxxx --mergeMain=true --refreshStale=true --validate=true runs the steps in order and prints the explicit DONE next command. WHY: verifies the core readiness orchestration reuses the existing lifecycle gates instead of bypassing them.

edge.desc: After a clean main merge changes the material hash and stale evidence dry-run classifies evidence as safely refreshable, refreshStale=true invokes verification_evidence_refresh_stale through the existing evidence path and then reruns validation against fresh material. WHY: covers the common post-merge evidence refresh path without manual sequencing.

adversarial.desc: When stale-evidence dry-run says evidence must be regenerated by rerunning commands, or when lattice validate fails after refresh, done_prepare stops immediately and does not call done_closure or print DONE-ready guidance. WHY: stale or failing validation must remain a blocker, not a hash rewrite or optimistic closure.

items.title: Report runtime-change post-DONE finalization guidance without mutating versions
items.context: Detect runtime-affecting diffs and report postDoneRuntimeVersionBumpRequired/postDoneNext. Do not touch package.json, lockfiles, or LATTICE_CLI_VERSION in done_prepare.
items.userSees: done_prepare reports whether post-DONE runtime patch finalization is required, names the follow-up path and version sources, and leaves all version files unchanged before DONE.

happy.desc: With a runtime-affecting diff under packages/main/src/core, packages/main/src/handlers, packages/main/src/tasks, packages/main/src/cli.ts, packages/main/src/index.ts, bin, lifecycle gate, validation, review, Authority, process-fact, or command-dispatch code, done_prepare reports postDoneRuntimeVersionBumpRequired=true and postDoneNext without changing version sources. WHY: runtime changes need post-DONE finalization but must not invalidate pre-DONE evidence.

edge.desc: With docs-only, story metadata-only, review evidence-only, or comment-only diffs, done_prepare reports postDoneRuntimeVersionBumpRequired=false and does not list a runtime patch bump as required. WHY: the classifier must avoid noisy finalization work for non-runtime changes.

adversarial.desc: When version source files are already inconsistent or an implementation tries to normalize them during done_prepare, the command reports postDoneVersionState: inconsistent with mismatched values but still refuses to mutate version files before DONE. WHY: pre-DONE automation must be diagnostic, not a hidden version bump path.

items.title: Render host-neutral readiness output and clean-tree blockers
items.context: Output PASS/BLOCKED summaries that distinguish localDoneReady, degraded-single-host local assurance, two-host status, Authority receipt backed completion, and production completion. If prepare produced metadata changes, block at cleanTree with exact files and commit guidance.
items.userSees: done_prepare prints PASS or BLOCKED readiness summaries that separate localDoneReady, degraded-single-host local assurance, two-host review status, Authority receipt backed completion, production completion, and cleanTree commit-required blockers.

happy.desc: For a fully locally ready TEST story with valid local closure gates and no Authority receipt, done_prepare prints a PASS summary that clearly separates local DONE readiness from Authority and production completion and prints exactly one explicit DONE next command. WHY: operators must see that local readiness is not production or Authority completion.

edge.desc: When done_closure or review_escalation_status reports degraded-single-host local readiness rather than two-host assurance, done_prepare renders the degraded local status without claiming two-host quorum, receiptVerified, authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, or productionDone. WHY: high-risk lifecycle work can be locally ready while still lacking independent Authority proof.

adversarial.desc: If done_prepare itself creates Lattice metadata during evidence refresh, validate, or closure inspection, the final clean-tree check blocks instead of printing PASS and lists the exact files that must be committed. WHY: DONE would fail on a dirty tree, so prepare must not create false readiness after its own mutations.

items.title: Add focused smoke coverage for done_prepare behavior
items.context: Cover clean ready path, dirty tree preflight, stale evidence classification, validate failure, runtime change detection without version mutation, docs-only no-finalization guidance, degraded-single-host wording, and dryRun no-mutation behavior.
items.userSees: The done_prepare smoke suite demonstrates ready, blocked, dry-run, stale-evidence, merge-conflict, runtime-guidance, degraded-assurance, and commit-required behavior with assertions on the exact terminal output and protected files.

happy.desc: Smoke a clean TEST story where mergeMain, stale evidence classification, validate, done_closure, runtime reporting, and final clean-tree checks all pass, and assert the DONE next command is printed once. WHY: proves the intended operator path works end to end without weakening DONE gates.

Smoke runtime source diff and docs-only diff classifications in separate cases, proving runtime changes require post-DONE patch guidance while docs-only changes do not, and neither case mutates version files before DONE. WHY: locks the version-discipline boundary into automated coverage.

edge.desc: Smoke dirty-tree preflight and refreshStale=false stale evidence cases: dirty worktree blocks before mutation, and stale evidence with --refreshStale=false blocks at evidenceFreshness with refresh guidance. WHY: both conditions are common operator boundaries that must stop early and visibly.

Smoke validate failure and degraded-single-host wording: validate failure stops at validate with the validate next command, while degraded local assurance renders local-only readiness without Authority, fullAuthority, production, receipt, or two-host overclaim. WHY: blocked validation and degraded assurance must not look like production completion.

Smoke prepare-generated metadata changes by arranging stale evidence refresh or validate to write .lattice story metadata, then assert the final cleanTree gate blocks with exact files and commit-required guidance. WHY: prepare must not report PASS while its own metadata writes would make DONE fail.

adversarial.desc: Smoke merge-main conflict by creating a conflicting local main change and story change, then running done_prepare --mergeMain=true; it stops at mergeMain, lists conflicted files, prints manual resolution guidance, and does not validate, refresh evidence, run runtime detection, or attempt DONE. WHY: automated pre-DONE merge must not auto-resolve conflicts or continue with conflicted state.

Smoke stale evidence that requires command rerun rather than safe refresh; done_prepare prints the rerun commands and refuses to rewrite hashes or mark the evidence fresh. WHY: stale evidence requiring regeneration must remain a real blocker.

Smoke dryRun=true against a scenario that would otherwise merge main, refresh stale evidence, or write metadata; it reports planned steps and blockers but leaves git state, evidence files, version files, and build outputs unchanged. WHY: dry-run must be trustworthy for operators inspecting risky closure work.
